biggest_catch: Your friend must be brand-new to SF Fire CU (18+, no prior membership), register via your link, join by opening a qualifying share account or loan product, AND fund it (at least $250 into the share account within 60 days of membership or loan funded within 90 days); your $50 arrives as a Mastercard Virtual Reward 2-3 weeks after all requirements complete.
catches: Referrer must be a current SF Fire CU member and must register at sffirecu.org/refer to get a referral portal and unique link.

Friend must register via your link and join by opening one qualifying product: share account (checking, tiered savings, money market, or term certificate) or loan product (credit card, personal, home, home equity, vehicle, or student loan). Indirect loans and trust/estate accounts are not eligible.
Friend must deposit at least $250 into the share account within 60 days of membership OR have the loan funded within 90 days.
At reward issuance, both referrer and friend must be 18+ with open accounts in good standing (no negative balances).

Reward issued as a $50 Mastercard Virtual Reward to the email provided at registration (physical card mailed if not subscribed to marketing emails); not transferable; delivery 2-3 weeks after completion (4-6 weeks for physical).
Referred person cannot have previously had a membership; if multiple members refer the same person, only the first referral counts.
Referral link never expires, but once the friend accepts and registers they have 180 days to complete the process.
Cap: $500 per calendar year for the referrer.
Employees are eligible for the $50 referrer bonus (but not the new-member $100).
Promotion runs September 1, 2026 through December 31, 2026; can be changed at any time without notice.
IRS Form 1099 issued if you receive $600 or more in prizes in a calendar year.

steps: Register at sffirecu.org/refer to access your ReferLive referral portal and unique link.
Send your unique link to friends via email or social media.
Friend registers via your link and joins SF Fire CU by opening a qualifying share account or loan product.
Friend funds at least $250 into the share account within 60 days of membership (or the loan is funded within 90 days).
You receive a $50 Mastercard Virtual Reward 2-3 weeks after all requirements are complete.
timing: Mastercard Virtual Reward delivered to the registration email 2-3 weeks after all requirements complete (4-6 weeks if physical card), with both accounts open and in good standing.
